newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Perilya year net profit rises 37 pct.
newsitem.headline: Perilya year net profit rises 37 pct.

text.p: Gold miner Perilya Mines NL said on Tuesday that 1995/96 net profit rose 37 percent to A$6.01 million, due to an increase of nearly 40 percent in output from the Fortnum mine in Western Australia.
The company, which recently raised A$8.5 million from an issue of 10 million ordinary shares to Mega First Corp Bhd, said gold revenues rose 34 percent to A$38.6 million.
Production from Fortnum was expected to rise to about 70,000 ounces in the current year from 68,019 ounces in 1995/96, with the exploration budget to rise by 40 percent to A$7 million.
